messages.title: Welcome message (send first, then pin it)
messages.text:
*Welcome to the FOM Studios group* 📸

This is where we share promos, giveaways, shoot availability and behind-the-scenes first.

Our giveaway goes live today: follow @fom_studios_ on Instagram, like the giveaway post and tag 2 friends for a chance to win a *FREE Mini Shoot*. Everyone who enters gets 10% off, and the code is posted here after entries close.

Bookings and quotes: message us on 068 690 1120 so nothing gets lost.

FOM Studios 📸
messages.why: Pinned at the top so new members know what the group is for and how to enter.

messages.title: Giveaway launch
messages.text:
🎁 *The FOM Studios giveaway is LIVE!*

Win a *FREE Mini Shoot* (R500 value), or 20% off one. Everyone who enters also gets *10% off* their first booking.

Enter on Instagram (@fom_studios_): follow, like the giveaway post and tag 2 friends in the comments. Each new comment tagging 2 different friends is another entry.

Entries close *Monday 7 December at 6PM*. Your 10% code and the winners will be posted right here in this group.

FOM Studios 📸

messages.title: Black Friday 15% off
messages.text:
*Black Friday: 15% off any FOM Studios shoot* 🎄

Book any shoot from Fri 27 Nov to Mon 30 Nov and get 15% off with the code *FOMBLACKFRIDAY*.

A shoot makes a great Christmas present: family photos, a couple shoot, or a car or sport reel for someone who loves their hobby.

Just mention FOMBLACKFRIDAY when you WhatsApp us on 068 690 1120 or use the Book a shoot button:
https://www.fomstudios.co.za/?src=wach

P.S. The Mini Shoot giveaway on Instagram is still open until Sunday 6 December. The two offers can't be combined.

FOM STUDIOS 📸

messages.title: Festive season shoots
messages.text:
*The festive season is here in Joburg* ✨

The Festival of Lights at Joburg Zoo opens on Thu 26 Nov, and public schools close on Wed 9 Dec.

If you want family photos, a couple shoot or your year-end function covered before everyone goes away, now is the time to get a date in.

Our Mini Shoot is R500 for 30 minutes (20 photos or 1 reel), and photography starts from R800.

See the packages and book here:
https://www.fomstudios.co.za/?src=wach

FOM STUDIOS 📸
